summary: Public research university in Istanbul with six faculties of mostly English-medium four-year degrees. International applicants need a score of 36 IB points.
about: International applicants apply once online in spring and need an accepted exam, an English proficiency result, and a statement of purpose. Boğaziçi gives no scholarships or aid to international students.

ib.text: IB Diploma: minimum 36 of 45 points. No subject rule or Course Results route is listed. Applicants may need to hold results at application; ask before using predicted scores.

apply.via: Boğaziçi online system for international students

languageOfInstruction.note: Boğaziçi states English is the language of instruction. Law and Turkish Language and Literature require B2 Turkish at application.

admissionRoutes.text: The recognised-exams list asks for a minimum IB Diploma score of 36/45 at the time of application. It does not state subject, HL or predicted-grade rules.
Only the full Diploma appears in the recognised list; no Course Results route is published. Ask Boğaziçi before relying on certificates.

notes: Documents: exam score report, official transcript, diploma or graduation letter, English proficiency report, statement of purpose, passport copy, and a USD 103 application fee. Everything must be in English. Dual-citizen Turkish applicants who studied abroad need entry-exit records.
Fall 2026 applications ran 6 Apr to 5 Jun 2026. Fall 2027 dates are not published. The recognised list expects results at application, so confirm how a May 2027 IB candidate applies.

English proof: TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic accepted from June 2026 at 4.5 on the new TOEFL scale or IELTS 6.5 with Writing 6.5; or the university's BUEPT. Online and Home Edition tests are not accepted. Exemption for three years of English-language secondary schooling in an English-speaking country. No IB English exemption is stated.

Tuition for international undergraduates: USD 10,000 a year (Economics and Administrative Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Engineering, English Prep); USD 8,000 (Education, Science, Law). The page is undated, so confirm the 2027-28 amount.
Four-year degrees are eight semesters, excluding a year in English Preparatory if you cannot document English. Boğaziçi offers no scholarships or financial aid to international students.
